'''FC Kazakhmys''' ({{langx|kk|Qazaqmys Fýtbol Klýby}}) is a defunct [[Kazakhstan]]i [[Football (soccer)|football]] club. They were based in [[Satpayev (city)|Satpayev]], [[Karagandy Province]]. They won the [[Kazakhstan First Division 2007|First Division 2007]], but were not able to start in the [[Kazakhstan Premier League|Premier League 2008]] due to financial difficulties. In the 2008 season, the club became champion again and promoted to the Kazakhstan Premier League. In May 2011, due to lack of funds, it was announced the discontinuity of the club. In 2015, Gadaleta Investment LLP (a company registered in Bermuda) expressed its interest in taking over the relevant licence and franchise through the Molfetta Eurasia Sport Trust.<ref>[http://sports.kz/news.php?id=43369&type=small&st=0000000010 Kazakhmys leaves the league] Sports.kz on 25 May 2011</ref>"}}
